class B {
  private static final Map<String, Entry> SESSIONS = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, Entry>();
  private static final Map<String, Entry> OLD_SESSIONS = new ConcurrentHashMap<String, Entry>();
  void login(String id) {
    OLD_SESSIONS.put(id, new Entry());
  }
  void a(String id) {
    SESSIONS.put(id, new Entry());
    SESSIONS.remove(id);
  }
}
